strict_requirements: closed and complete normalized activity stream
fixed collector name and normalizer revision
positive non-vacuous model-forward call and GPU-time evidence
covered calls and GPU time equal their exact denominators
no fallback, classification, duplicate, or provenance violation

publication.interprocess_lock: nonblocking flock held for auditor lifetime
publication.partial_to_final: same owning instance and exact prior-byte SHA-256 only
publication.write: temporary file, file fsync, atomic replace, directory fsync
publication.relative_paths: resolved before lock acquisition and stable across chdir

tests.independent_reviews: two approvals after all P1 fixes, no remaining P0/P1

claim_boundary: The module audits adapter-supplied normalized events.
It does not collect GPU activity or prove collector completeness.
It does not validate the GPU timing method.
A strict policy pass is not model correctness, profiler completeness, runtime coverage evidence, or performance evidence.
